e: From a pronunciation of hospital with h-dropping, + -ie.
q: I became most distressed when talking to a man from Liverpool who said he was going up the ozzie? I thought he was planning to examine an Australian, but it turned out he was going to the hospital.

What a way to start the new century – in the ozzie or a police cell.
